pages.text: Every dust in this chapter comes from the Akaishi Pulverizer: ores in, dust out, and the downstream machines decide what happens next. Dust is the $(4)universal middleman$(0) for the Compressor and the Transformer — press it into blocks or turn it into bases, depending on what you're short of.$(br2)To stock up, set up a power grid and one Pulverizer: it eats normal and deepslate ores alike, and even Akaishi ore and Obsidian.

$(bold)The full dust menu:$(0)$(li)Akaishi Dust: 9 press into 1 Akaishi Essence$(li)Coal Dust: 9 press into 1 Coal Block$(li)Iron Dust / Gold Dust: 9 press into the matching block$(li)Copper Dust: 9 press into 1 Copper Block$(li)Lapis Dust: 9 press into 1 Lapis Block — or turn 1 into a Cooling Base$(li)Diamond Dust / Emerald Dust: 9 press into the matching block$(li)Quartz Dust: 9 press into 1 Quartz Block$(li)Netherite Dust: 9 press into 1 Netherite Ingot$(li)Obsidian Dust: $(4)4 press into 1 Obsidian$(0)$(br2)For the pressing details, see the Compressor — feed the Pulverizer the ore that matches the dust you need.

Dust is made by the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) and consumed by the $(l:akaishi:compressor)Compressor$(/l); for the journey from mineral to metal, read $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l).
